description.value:
Your eidolon is a sacred feathered serpent. Coatl eidolon can resemble all manner of coatl, though a majestic skybound serpent covered in radiant plumage is the most common. A bond with a coatl comes most often when a coatl has already chosen to guide and defend the settlement the summoner resides.

Tradition Divine

Traits beast, coatl, eidolon, holy

Home Plane the Universe

Size Medium or Small

Suggested Attacks coil (bludgeoning), wings (bludgeoning), jaws (piercing)

Eidolon Attributes Con +1, Int +0, Wis +1, Cha +1

Skills Diplomacy, Religion

Senses darkvision

Language one common language

Speed 15 feet; fly 20 feet

Initial (1st) @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.su-eidolons.Item.fB08hAHytVnyLBjl]{Skybound Serpent}

When flying due to the eidolon's innate fly speed, it must begin and end its movement on a solid surface or immediately fall. If it gains another fly speed, increase that fly speed by 10 feet. Additionally, your eidolon's unarmed Strikes gain the holy trait.

Symbiosis (7th) @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.su-eidolons.Item.4SUCZ5dvsW698TR2]{Radiant Wings} 2

Your eidolon unfurls its radiant wings in a grand display. Each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] must attempt a @Check[will|against:class|options:area-effect] save against your class DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round, and dazzled for 1 minute. If the creature was unholy, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Critical Failure The creature is blinded for 1 round, dazzled for 1 minute, and stunned 1. If the creature was unholy, the creature is stunned 2.

Transcendence (17th) @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.su-eidolons.Item.UJfG1kp0kAf7GcR1]{Serpent Hope}

Your eidolon is surrounded by an aura of hope in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. It has the aura and divine traits. Whenever your eidolon becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, reduce the condition value by 1 (to a minimum of 0). At the end of your turn, each ally in the eidolon's aura reduces its frightened value by 1. Allies within your eidolon's aura gain a +2 status bonus to saves against fear and unholy effects and are immune to the effects of your eidolon's Radiant Wings.

Allies in the aura receive @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.summons-unleashed.Item.sGiACqCE3eCa9qW7]{Effect: Serpent Hope} automatically.

Eidolon actor: give your eidolon the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.su-eidolons.Item.M2kN0VjJ9VxThg90]{Coatl Eidolon} ancestry from the Summons Unleashed Eidolons compendium.
